segments.description: The Semiconductor Test segment includes operations related to the design, manufacturing and marketing of semiconductor test products and services inclusive of storage and system level test products.
The Robotics segment includes operations related to the design, manufacturing and marketing of collaborative robotic arms and autonomous mobile robots.

reconciling.note: System Test and Wireless Test are included within the 'All other' segments category.

reporting_note: As of December 31, 2024, Teradyne has two reportable segments (Semiconductor Test and Robotics). Each of the reportable segments continues to represent an individual operating segment.
